'''Sith troopers''' were [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] used by various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] factions during the [[New Sith Wars]], serving under different banners such as the [[Daimanate]],<ref name="Aflame 1" /> the [[Odionate]]<ref name="Aflame 1" /> and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="DB:POD" />

==History==
Sith troopers were in use during or after [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]], following the emergence of [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]] and his [[New Sith|Sith Empire]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. They were similar to the [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|identically-named troopers]] who served the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], as well as the [[Imperial soldier]]s used by [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate's]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="DB:POD" /> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] used [[Daimanate Sith trooper|troopers]] as the bulk of the [[Daimanate]]'s infantry. During the time of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] in the last decade of the New Sith Wars, Sith troopers were used by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] as the bulk of infantry forces during the Brotherhood's ground and space campaigns. Their ranks were comprised of poor or desperate beings who felt that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] had abandoned their cause while others were mercenaries and bounty hunters hired to fight in the wars.<ref name="Aflame 1" />
